patch_list: Bypass Signature and Installer Verification - MT Manager (Experimental)

Spoofs Google Play Store installation source and neutralizes Java-side APK signature and package verification checks in MT Manager. NOTE: Native integrity checks via libmtprotect.so may still require system-level signature spoofing.
Remove Ads and Update Prompts - MT Manager (Experimental)
Removes in-app promotional banners and interstitial advertisements, disables forced update dialogs, and suppresses upgrade nag screens across MT Manager.
Unlock VIP Features and Themes - MT Manager (Experimental)
